title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer, fines team $30M, Kawhi Leonard $700K in cap circumvention case
content: Los Angeles Clippers owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year by the NBA, and the team was ordered to pay $30 million for violating salary cap circumvention rules in a case involving Kawhi Leonard.

title: The IRS slashed its staff. One result? More taxes going uncollected
content: The IRS slashed its auditing staff last year — but the move may have backfired as tax collections from enforcement efforts plummeted, an Inspector General report shows.

title: A jury in Malta acquits a businessman in the killing of reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia
content: Investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia had written extensively about suspected corruption in political and business circles in Malta. She was killed by a car bomb in 2017, at age 53.

title: New Jersey asks Supreme Court to resolve fight over Kalshi's future
content: If the high court accepts the petition, it would tee up a case with sweeping implications for prediction markets, an industry that has unleashed billions of dollars of betting across nearly every aspect of modern life.

title: New immigration court tactic leads to huge lines and chaos in Miami
content: Chaos unfolds at the Miami immigration court after judges are assigned mega master calendars, hearings where judges see more than 100 immigrants at once.

title: Understanding the tech giants' oversized influence in American schools
content: Big tech companies like Apple and Microsoft use devices, training and conferences for teachers and students to embed in schools. The New York Times' Natasha Singer discusses the impact in Coding Kids.

title: Iran fires on its Gulf neighbors, retaliating for U.S. strikes after a monthlong lull
content: The six-month war has led to a spike in oil prices, roiled the global economy and posed increasing political problems for President Trump's Republican Party ahead of November midterm elections.

title: Greetings from the Royal Pavilion, a stunning reminder of India in southern England
content: Looking up at this 18th century building, it became clear the British didn't only bring their architectural style to India. They also took some of India's style home.

title: Chevron to expand in Venezuela, days after the U.S. and Venezuela strike oil deal
content: Chevron is the largest foreign oil operator in Venezuela. The deal will expand its footprint at a time of political and economic uncertainty for Venezuela.

title: Medical groups offer vaccine guidance to fill federal vacuum
content: In the unprecedented absence of federal guidance, leading medical groups are issuing their own recommendations for who should get the COVID-19, flu and RSV immunizations.
